# DAViewer v0.5.18

## 本次更新

- 改善浏览和分页时的登录状态稳定性，减少不必要的恢复提示。
- 推荐中的不确定信号不再单独触发警告，加载失败时保留已有内容并提供重试。
- 优化提醒框的亮暗主题、窄屏和大字体显示，关闭按钮及操作始终可见。
- 合并重复操作提示，避免隐藏页面弹出过期结果，并防止已关闭的更新提醒反复出现。

## What's New

- Improve session stability while browsing and loading more items, reducing unnecessary recovery prompts.
- Uncertain recommendation signals no longer raise warnings on their own; failed loads preserve existing content and offer retry.
- Improve reminders in light/dark themes, narrow screens and large text, keeping actions and close controls accessible.
- Coalesce duplicate feedback, suppress stale results from hidden pages, and prevent dismissed update reminders from reappearing.
